Reports indicate that up to 70 missiles of various types are reportedly prepared for launch from five locations in Russia, raising the possibility of another attack at any moment. The reported deployments include up to 18 Iskander-M/K missiles, 5 S-400 ballistic missiles and 5 Oniks-M anti-ship missiles in the Bryansk region; 7 Zircon hypersonic missiles and 5 Oniks-M missiles in the Kursk region; 3 Zircon hypersonic missiles and 7 KN-23/24 ballistic missiles in the Voronezh region; 11 Iskander-M ballistic missiles and 3 Zircon hypersonic missiles in Millerovo; and 6 Iskander-M ballistic missiles in Taganrog. 💪 Follow Us | Discussion 💪
